scripts.text: - There is a strange distortion here -
scripts.translation: - 这里的空间似乎有些扭曲。-

scripts.text: - I extend my arm as a fierce sound resonates in my ear and a cool wave surrounds me -
scripts.translation: - 我伸出手臂，耳边响起刺耳的声音，一股清凉的波动随即裹住了我。-

scripts.text: - There is a strange distortion here -
scripts.translation: - 这里的空间似乎有些扭曲。-

scripts.text: - There appears to be nothing here. But I can definitely feel something around here... -
scripts.translation: - 这里似乎什么都没有。但我确实能感觉到周围有什么东西...-

scripts.text: - I extend my arm as a fierce sound resonates in my ear and a cool wave surrounds me -
scripts.translation: - 我伸出手臂，耳边响起刺耳的声音，一股清凉的波动随即裹住了我。-

scripts.text: - You decide to leave it alone. -
This is only connected with a special gate!
scripts.translation: 这里明明只和一扇特殊的门相连！

scripts.text: But we should leave before my master spots you...!
scripts.translation: 不过在主人发现你之前，我们得赶紧离开...！

scripts.text: I warned them to be quiet while I'm meditating.
scripts.translation: 我说过我冥想时要保持安静。

scripts.text: Oh~ there's a human being in front of me.
scripts.translation: 哦~我面前居然有个人类。

scripts.text: I was just leading it out.
There's the warp portal beyond you... Is it an illusion?
scripts.translation: 你身后有个传送门...那是幻觉吗？

scripts.text: I'll deal with you after you send the human away.
scripts.translation: 把人类送走后我再收拾你。

scripts.text: - The fairy with the green hair chants a spell. -
scripts.translation: - 绿发妖精开始吟唱咒语。 -

scripts.text: - I feel like something special surrounds me. -
scripts.translation: - 我感觉有某种特殊力量包围着我。 -

scripts.text: How dare you resist me human?
I'm not sure. Who are you?
I am the leader of the ^000077Warlock^000000s.
If you are a Wizard, it would be good of you to memorize my name.
scripts.translation: 如果你是巫师，最好记住我的名字。

scripts.text: A ^000077Warlock^000000 is someone who uses the magic of the giants of Jotunheim.
scripts.translation: ^000077咒术士^000000是运用约顿海姆巨人魔法的人。

scripts.text: It can't be defined in any other words.
scripts.translation: 除此之外没有别的定义。

scripts.text: Only the strong magic can explain it.
scripts.translation: 只有强大的魔法才能说明一切。
我可以成为大魔导士吗？

scripts.text: You want to become a Warlock?
It would be difficult for a human to become a Warlock.
scripts.translation: 人类想成为咒术士可不容易。

scripts.text: The strong power would gnaw at your weak body.
scripts.translation: 强大的力量会侵蚀你脆弱的身体。

scripts.text: If you dare to face death, you can try to become one.
scripts.translation: 如果你敢面对死亡，可以试着成为咒术士。

scripts.text: What do I need to do?
You hunger for power don't you human.
The strong desire to be more powerful makes your soul more beautiful.
scripts.translation: 对更强力量的渴望，让你的灵魂更加美丽。

scripts.text: But, I need to check that you're qualified.
scripts.translation: 不过，我得确认你是否有资格。

scripts.text: Talk to the guy with the weird hair.
scripts.translation: 去和那个头发奇怪的家伙说话。

scripts.text: He'll let you know what you should do.
scripts.translation: 他会告诉你接下来该做什么。

scripts.text: You are a human being so that's for you.
scripts.translation: 既然你是人类，这个就给你。

scripts.text: You're still quite far too low of a level to even consider this.
scripts.translation: 你的等级还差得远，暂时不用考虑这件事。

scripts.text: Can you imagine how severely I was scolded by my master?!
scripts.translation: 你能想象我被主人骂得有多惨吗？！

scripts.text: If you have any business with me, just go away!
scripts.translation: 有事的话就快说，没事就走开！

scripts.text: My master will deal with you then.
scripts.translation: 到时候主人会处理你的。

scripts.text: Dear, master! My pony-tail is funny looking?!
scripts.translation: 主人！我的马尾辫看起来很奇怪吗？！

scripts.text: Oh, but I spent a lot time on it!
scripts.translation: 可是我花了好多时间整理呢！

scripts.text: First, use all of your remaining job skill points before continuing.
scripts.translation: 首先，在继续之前，请用完你剩余的职业技能点。
决定，所以告诉我你的想法。

scripts.text: We need to test if your body can withstand being a Warlock.
scripts.translation: 我们得测试你的身体能否承受咒术士的力量。

scripts.text: So you need to gather materials to prove yourself.
scripts.translation: 所以你要收集材料证明自己。

scripts.text: Please gather ^000077Glittering Crystal^000000s and ^000077Giant Bradium Fragment^000000s.
I can't conduct the task here. I need to go to my lab.
scripts.translation: 我不能在这里进行测试，得回我的实验室。

scripts.text: My lab is located on the north western part of Splendide.
scripts.translation: 我的实验室在斯普兰迪德西北方。

scripts.text: A Magic Chamber is created from magic materials.
scripts.translation: 魔法石室是用魔法材料建造的。

scripts.text: This combined stone is formed differently according to the raw materials and the way of treating it.
scripts.translation: 这种合成石会因原材料和处理方式不同而形成不同形态。

scripts.text: But most of stones are quite similar!
scripts.translation: 不过大多数石头都很相似！
我们很难轻易分辨它们。

scripts.text: Even I don't know how it all works.
scripts.translation: 连我也不知道具体原理。

scripts.text: You must be wearing these Magical Stone Rings to get these items while hunting.
scripts.translation: 狩猎时必须戴着这些魔法石戒指，才能获得这些物品。

scripts.text: You need to hunt Naga and Bradium Golems while wearing these rings.
scripts.translation: 戴上戒指去狩猎纳迦和布拉迪姆魔像。

scripts.text: Show us how strong you are. And don't forget to wear this.
scripts.translation: 让我们看看你的实力。别忘了戴上这个。

scripts.text: Bring these stones with you or else you won't be able to return!
scripts.translation: 把这些石头带在身上，否则你就回不来了！

scripts.text: The person next to my Master will let you out if you talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和主人旁边那个人说话，他会让你出去。

scripts.text: My lab is located on the north western part of Splendide. Bring these to me when you've gathered them.
scripts.translation: 我的实验室在斯普兰迪德西北方。收集齐后把东西带来给我。

scripts.text: We need to test if your body can withstand being a Warlock.
scripts.translation: 我们得测试你的身体能否承受咒术士的力量。

scripts.text: So you need to gather materials to prove yourself.
scripts.translation: 所以你要收集材料证明自己。

scripts.text: Please gather ^000077Glittering Crystal^000000s and ^000077Giant Bradium Fragment^000000s.
You must be wearing these Magical Stone Rings to get these items while hunting.
scripts.translation: 狩猎时必须戴着这些魔法石戒指，才能获得这些物品。

scripts.text: You need to hunt Naga and Bradium Golems while wearing these rings.
scripts.translation: 戴上戒指去狩猎纳迦和布拉迪姆魔像。

scripts.text: Bring these stones with you or else you won't be able to return!
scripts.translation: 把这些石头带在身上，否则你就回不来了！

scripts.text: Bring me back the magical stones.
It seems that you don't have it?
Please find that stone and come back to me.
scripts.translation: 请找到那块石头再回来。

scripts.text: Alright! All the materials are ready!
While I am concentrating on working on this stone. Can you go back to my master?
scripts.translation: 我会专心制作这块石头。你能先回去找主人吗？

scripts.text: I will follow up once it's done.
I asked you to double check it and make sure you wore it!
scripts.translation: 我不是叫你仔细确认并戴上它吗！

scripts.text: Please check whether you misplaced it or if you already have it equipped.
scripts.translation: 检查一下是不是放错位置，或者已经装备上了。

scripts.text: It's not hard to tell if you have it or not!
scripts.translation: 有没有戴上明明一眼就看得出来！

scripts.text: Just show me your good faith!
How can you can say that?
I guess I could give you more stones if you give me say a 3 carat diamond...
scripts.translation: 如果你给我一颗3克拉钻石...我倒是可以再给你些石头。

scripts.text: You sure you don't have it?
Then what's that you are holding now...?
scripts.translation: 那你现在拿着的是什么...？

scripts.text: Don't bother me, I am quite busy.
And... you seem to have more talent on this than regular mages.
scripts.translation: 而且...你似乎比普通魔法师更有天赋。

scripts.text: Maybe if I become an alchemist, I might be better than I am now don't you think?
scripts.translation: 你说我如果转职成炼金术士，会不会比现在更厉害？
我正在学习，让自己变得更强。

scripts.text: If am inside of 'the room of time and magic', I will catch up with your power!
scripts.translation: 只要我进到‘时空魔法之室’，一定能赶上你的力量！

scripts.text: It's not me you are looking for currently.
scripts.translation: 你现在要找的人不是我。

scripts.text: You're carring out too many items.
We can create the magic stone in the magic room.
scripts.translation: 我们可以在魔法室制造魔法石。

scripts.text: Be careful of the monsters in the test room.
These are rainbow Rubies sealed with a Warlock's magic.
scripts.translation: 这些是用咒术士魔法封印的彩虹红宝石。

scripts.text: I will guide you into the magic room.
You're carring out too many items.
Would you like to try it again?
Let me give you more rubies.
You have successfully crystallized the Hollow Stone.
scripts.translation: 你成功将空洞石结晶化了。

scripts.text: I'm sorry that I've doubted you.
All of the tests are done. Now talk to Master Engoloria.
scripts.translation: 所有测试都完成了。现在去和艾格诺莉亚大师谈谈。

scripts.text: I'm so happy that you have succeeded.
All of the tests are done. Now talk to Master Engoloria.
scripts.translation: 所有测试都完成了。现在去和艾格诺莉亚大师谈谈。

scripts.text: I'm so happy that you have succeeded.
I can feel that you have strong magic.
scripts.translation: 我能感受到你强大的魔力。

scripts.text: If you don't have anything to say to me, would you just leave?
scripts.translation: 如果没什么要说的，可以离开了吗？

scripts.text: Please be quiet while my master is meditating.
scripts.translation: 主人冥想时请保持安静。

scripts.text: Do you have something to ask me?
How can I be a Warlock?
You hunger for power don't you human.
The strong desire to be more powerful makes your soul more beautiful.
scripts.translation: 对更强力量的渴望，让你的灵魂更加美丽。

scripts.text: But, I need to check that you're qualified.
scripts.translation: 不过，我得确认你是否有资格。

scripts.text: Talk to the guy with the weird hair.
scripts.translation: 去和那个头发奇怪的家伙说话。

scripts.text: He'll let you know what you should do.
scripts.translation: 他会告诉你接下来该做什么。

scripts.text: You are a human being so that's for you.
scripts.translation: 既然你是人类，这个就给你。

scripts.text: I'm meditating, I said talk to Yoop ok.
scripts.translation: 我在冥想。我说了，去找优普，好吗？

scripts.text: I've heard from Yoop that a very useful stone can be created.
scripts.translation: 我听优普说可以制作一种非常实用的石头。

scripts.text: It can be used to make magical jewelry that can cast powerful magic.
scripts.translation: 它可以制作成能够施放强力魔法的饰品。

scripts.text: Please take him to the magical room.
My master is meditating now, please follow me.
scripts.translation: 主人现在正在冥想，请跟我来。

scripts.text: How did you come this far...
Please come back after reducing the number of items you have.
scripts.translation: 减少物品数量后再回来。

scripts.text: Unless you like your current job, you should use all your skill points.
scripts.translation: 如果你不喜欢当前职业，请先用完所有技能点。

scripts.text: You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation: 请先解除坐骑装备再试！

scripts.text: Don't make me disappointed at you...
You have become a member of the Warlocks.
scripts.translation: 你已成为咒术士的一员。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou still have left the skill points, Please use all the skill points and try to start again!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你还有剩余的技能点，请使用完所有技能点后再试一次！^000000

scripts.text: This crystallized magical stone will keep you safe.
scripts.translation: 这块结晶化的魔法石会保护你。

scripts.text: How are you adjusting to the power of a Warlocks?
scripts.translation: 你适应咒术士的力量了吗？

scripts.text: If you get careless, you will be overthrown by your own power.
scripts.translation: 如果掉以轻心，你会被自己的力量吞噬。

scripts.text: If you ask Ebein to be sent to the magical room, he would send you there.
scripts.translation: 请艾贝因送你去魔法室，他会带你过去。

scripts.text: Wait in the queue to enter the Chamber of Magic.
scripts.translation: 请排队等候进入魔法石室。

scripts.text: Would you like to take a test?
If you stand by in the waiting room, you'll be able to go into the Chamber of Magic.
scripts.translation: 在等候室待命，就能进入魔法石室。

scripts.text: If there're others inside the room, you just need to wait for a while.
scripts.translation: 如果里面还有其他人，稍等一会儿即可。

scripts.text: Then please enter the room yourself.
Make sure you have enough potions to survive the test as the monsters are very powerful in the Chamber.
scripts.translation: 石室里的魔物非常强大，请准备足够的药水以通过测试。

scripts.text: Then I will send you outside.
